apis.publish_release: Returns the exact reference dictionary {path, sha256} for capture_release.json. Requires current producer os.getpid, positive observation reference, and producer_lock_before_release.json reference.
apis.acknowledge_release: Returns the exact reference dictionary {path, sha256} for capture_release_observed.json. Writes capture_release_observed.raw first from one actual pinned capture_release.json read; no numerical modules may be loaded. actual_process must be the actual current child snapshot.
apis.validate_saved_release: Returns capture_release, capture_release_observed, capture_release_observed_bytes reference dictionaries, capture_release_observed_at_seconds, prework_chronology_verified=true, scientific_credit=0 and admission_granted=false. Optional work is an execution-identity mapping with pid, process_start_time, started_at_seconds, finished_at_seconds.

required_sidecar: producer_lock_before_release.json contains the actual local producer descriptor snapshot plus observed_at_seconds. Its eight existing raw lock fields must match intent.producer_lock_before; the main observer retains direct.validate_descriptor verification.
scope: Only the two new source/test files were edited.
No parent source file, original numerical file, rejected snapshot, experiment packet or admission record changed.

Fixtures used only labelled temporary metadata and synthetic proc records; they launched no tool or payload process, sent no signal and opened no GPU or standing lock. The test runner used the approved existing CPU step.
No commit was created; parent owns integration, freeze and independent review.
